item.title: Rallying Cry – July 13, 2026
item.description: Gibraltar is celebrating the end of a 118-year-old border with Spain, while the UK kicks off trials for a rapid Ebola vaccine, Singapore and Malaysia strengthen their future-focused partnership, and a new mega-charging hub for electric trucks opens in Jurong.
